## BICLOPS HERO (CR 16)

**XP** 76,800  

Biclops fighter 4  
 N Huge humanoid (giant)  

**Init** +6; **Senses** low-light vision; Perception +21  

  

**Defense**

 **AC** 31, touch 10, flat-footed 28 (+1 dodge, +8 armor, +2 Dex, +12 natural, -2 size)  

**hp** 275 (17d8+136 plus 4d10+32 plus 4)  

**Fort** +22; **Ref** +10; **Will** +10; +1 vs. fear  

**Defensive Abilities** bravery +1, rock catching  

  

**Offense**

 **Speed** 40 ft.  

**Melee** 2 +1 longswords +27/+22/+17/+11 (3d6+13/18–20)  

**Ranged** 2 masterwork spears +16 (3d6+11/x3) or 2 rocks +16 (2d6+15)  

**Space** 15 ft.; **Reach** 15 ft.  

**Special Attacks** rock throwing (140 ft.), superior two-weapon fighting  

  

**Statistics**

 **Str** 33, **Dex** 14, **Con** 26, **Int** 10, **Wis** 14, **Cha** 10  

**Base Atk** +16; **CMB** +28 (+30 bull rush, overrun); **CMD** 41 (43 vs. bull rush, overrun)  

 **Feats** Awesome Blow, Cleave, Critical Focus, [Powerful Maneuvers](../../rules/feats/powerful-maneuvers.md), Improved Critical (longsword), Intimidating Prowess, Iron Will, Lightning Reflexes, Martial Weapon Proficiency (longsword), Quick Draw, Weapon Focus (longsword), Weapon Specialization (longsword), [Dodgility](../../rules/feats/dodge.md), [Improved Initiative](../../rules/feats/improved-initiative.md); [Power Attack](../../rules/feats/power-attack.md) (no feat needed)**Skills**  Climb +18, Craft (any) +9, Intimidate +32, Perception +21; **Racial Modifiers** +2 Perception  

**Languages** Common, Giant  

**SQ** armor training 1  

**Combat Gear** 2 potion of cure serious wounds; **Other Gear** +2 chainmail, 2 +1 longswords, 2 masterwork spears
